title: Cellular Inference Mesh: Salabim DES of edge-cloud LLM inference under PACELC saturation
description: Discrete-event simulation in Salabim of the Cellular Inference Mesh edge-cloud architecture for industrial multilingual AGV voice command processing under PACELC. Implements 300 Monte-Carlo replicates over 3 scenarios and 2 arms for 1800 simulated seconds, with parametric variation per replicate over realistic operational ranges. Verifies the Pareto-Efficiency Theorem (over 5 axes against 256 sub-compositions and 7 external architectures) and articulates the Saturated Pipeline Conjecture, which explains the structural insensitivity of percentile-99 latency to fallback-rate reductions under edge saturation. Reproducibility guaranteed via SHA-256 hash chain, seed_canonical=42, 53 pytest tests with bit-parity.
notes: Bit-parity verified: re-execution under seed_canonical=42 produces SHA-256 hashes identical to docs/hash-chain.md. See test_reproducibility for the cross-check.
